messages.ko: 안뇽 우리는 타이페이 스케줄 마치구 한국 가는즁!!!
messages.en: Hiii, we've finished our schedule in Taipei and we're on our way back to Korea!!!
Looks like you successfully became an airport goddess?
Reaaally??
Hehe

messages.ko: 하연이와 지우의 키스 사건에 대해 어떻게 생각하시나요?
messages.en: What do you think about the kissing incident between Hayeon and Jiwoo?
What incident are you talking about...?
Was that sooo?
I'm drinking Taipei milk tea right now,
It's insane!
It's sooo delicious.
OMG..... BRING SOME ALL THE WAY BACK TO KOREA!!!!!!!
I'll keep some in my mouth and bring it back.
Hehe
I'm on the plane now.
I'll get back to Korea safelyyy.

messages.ko: 진짜 밀크티 가져오는건가 입이 야무지게 닫혀있네
messages.en: Are you really bringing the milk tea back? Your mouth is firmly shut.
It's inside.
Oh right, when we came to Taipei,
the NXT members sat together.

messages.ko: 가끔 차에서나 스케줄할때 넥스트끼리 뭉치는 날 있으면
messages.en: Sometimes, when the NXT members get together in the car or during schedules,
all four of us feel like we've gone back to our trainee days,
and we get that same feeling we had back then.
I love it so much.
Huh, did you know each other when you were trainees?
We trained together for about two months, I think.
There were several of us.
That photo where only a V sign showed up comes to mind.
The secret behind that photo...
We'll be able to reveal it someday, right?
Like, maybe my hand wasn't even in it,
or something like that.
No ㅋㅋㅋ that's a huge clue to tease us with.
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ It's a secret.

messages.ko: 뭐야 알고보니 막 하연이 사실 글로우였는데 번호 바뀌고 그런거 아니지??
messages.en: Wait, don't tell me Hayeon was actually Glow all along, but then her number changed or something??
Ooh~
But I do like 19~~
But Jeong Hayeon is just so very 19.
I can't imagine being any other number.
I'm S11 Jeong Hayeon~
I'm S5 Jeong Hayeon~~
It doesn't suit me.
The plane is moving.
I'm going to sleep really well nowww.
Byeee, Haranghae☺️☺️😍
